scope: Bounded expanded development gate: representation x readout factorial, no SNN or final-benchmark claims

quality.duplicate_sha_policy: remove all colliding selected files, and exclude any hash matching prior pilot; no replacements

flow.mask: same valid backward-warp mask applied to both raw and aligned residuals

training.checkpoint_selection: minimum calibration clean BCE; tie earliest

limitations: Single real source and two legacy fake generators; not cross-generator generalization.
Historical audit data already used for metadata diagnostics; no confirmatory test claims.
Nominal-CFR index plan with recorded decoded timestamps; comprehensive source timing still not certified.
Resizing/cropping removes metadata fields but cannot guarantee removal of resampling or codec fingerprints.
Corruptions are applied after spatial preprocessing; they do not simulate full platform transmission.
Small random-initialized CNN/GRU baselines; not reproductions of MAST or other published detectors.
All four neural models have exactly 49,601 parameters; compute cost and optimization are not guaranteed equal.
Old pilot real prefixes and fake paths/hashes excluded; fake prompt ancestry and semantic content independence remain unresolved.
All data are still from the historical v02 pool, not an external confirmatory cohort.
No full-file content deduplication or real-source/generator label authentication beyond available records.

selection.roles: 60/20/20 within real and each fake source

decision_gate.primary: AUC(mean-seed aligned_temporal probabilities) minus AUC(mean-seed aligned_bag probabilities), clean development audit
support_required: per-seed clean delta >0 in at least 2 of 3 seeds
decision_gate.if_not_supported: Do not scale SNN/transport memory. Deprioritize ordering-specific architecture; examine representation, residual statistics and codec/resampling confounds. Inconclusive is not proof of no temporal benefit.
decision_gate.secondary: Aligned vs raw within each readout; simple residual-statistics logistic probe; all conditions reported
